checks.name: 7 routes registered
checks.detail: router.go registers exactly 7 POST routes under /api/v1/order/order: create-from-checkout, cancel-on-checkout-failure (internalGroup), detail, list-mine, cancel-mine (customerGroup), list-admin, update-status-admin (adminGroup).

checks.name: FULL routes: create-from-checkout, detail, list-mine
checks.detail: handler_create_from_checkout.go, handler_detail.go, handler_list_mine.go are fully implemented with correct transaction steps, ownership scoping, and response shapes per TD.

checks.name: FULL route: payment.completed consumer
checks.detail: consumer.go onPaymentCompleted is fully implemented: consumed_events dedup (layer 1), SELECT FOR UPDATE, state-driven PENDING_PAYMENT guard (layer 2), UpdateStatus + history INSERT in single tx. Matches td.json pseudocode exactly.

checks.name: STUB routes: cancel-mine, list-admin, update-status-admin, cancel-on-checkout-failure
checks.detail: All four stubs return 501. Each file contains full TODO comments specifying the required implementation contract (FOR UPDATE, ValidateTransition, outbox, admin_action_log). Compliant with v0.1 scope.

checks.name: STUB consumers: payment.failed, payment.expired, reservation.expired
checks.detail: consumer.go onPaymentFailed, onPaymentExpired, onReservationExpired are stubs returning nil with slog TODO. All three are registered in RegisterConsumerRoutes (map keyed by event type string). Compliant with v0.1 scope.

checks.name: State machine encoded as 2-D map in state_machine.go
checks.detail: state_machine.go defines allowedTransitions as map[transitionKey]transitionMeta — a single 2-D map keyed by (From, To, Actor) struct. O(1) lookup. Exactly matches TD §state_machine encoding choice.

checks.name: 10 allowed transitions encoded
checks.detail: Verified 10 entries in allowedTransitions: PENDING_PAYMENT→{PAID/PAYMENT_FAILED/PAYMENT_EXPIRED/CANCELLED×3}, PAID→{PACKING/CANCELLED}, PACKING→SHIPPED, SHIPPED→DELIVERED. Matches TD §state_machine.allowed_transitions exactly.

checks.name: 14 forbidden transitions covered
checks.detail: ValidateTransition uses terminal-state fast-path (PAYMENT_FAILED, PAYMENT_EXPIRED, CANCELLED, DELIVERED → immediate ErrInvalidTransition) plus implicit-deny (anything not in allowedTransitions map). All 14 TD §forbidden_transitions are unreachable. No gap found.

checks.name: Order number: global Postgres sequence
checks.detail: migration 002 creates single global sequence order.order_number_seq START 1 INCREMENT 1. NextOrderNumber in storage_order.go calls SELECT nextval('order.order_number_seq') inside the open tx and formats ORD-%s-%06d. No per-day sequence.

checks.name: Order number format: ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN
checks.detail: handler_create_from_checkout.go passes now.Format("20060102") as datePart; NextOrderNumber returns fmt.Sprintf("ORD-%s-%06d", datePart, seq). Zero-padded to 6 digits. Exact format match.

checks.name: Internal-auth middleware on create-from-checkout
checks.detail: router.go binds InternalAuthMiddleware(d.cfg.Internal.SharedSecret) to the internalGroup which covers both create-from-checkout and cancel-on-checkout-failure. middleware_internal_auth.go checks X-Internal-Secret header (const HeaderInternalSecret). Returns 401 on mismatch.

checks.name: Header constant is X-Internal-Secret
checks.detail: const HeaderInternalSecret = "X-Internal-Secret" in middleware_internal_auth.go. Exposed in allowedHeaders() in router.go for CORS. Matches TD §transport/internal_auth.

checks.name: Migration tables match TD: orders, order_items, order_status_history, outbox_events, consumed_events, admin_action_log
checks.detail: 003 → orders (correct columns, UNIQUE order_number, 4 indexes). 004 → order_items (FK ON DELETE RESTRICT, no UPDATE path) + order_status_history (actor_role CHECK). 005 → outbox_events (partial index published_at IS NULL) + consumed_events (PK event_id). 006 → admin_action_log.

checks.name: order.detail: owner-or-admin scoping, 404 no-existence-leak
checks.detail: handler_detail.go: ADMIN branch calls GetByID (any order, 404 NOT_FOUND on miss). CUSTOMER branch calls GetByID then checks o.UserID != claims.Sub → 404 ORDER_NOT_OWNED in both miss and wrong-owner cases. No 403; enumeration resistance preserved.

checks.name: Consumer: events.payment.completed FULL state-driven
checks.detail: onPaymentCompleted: BEGIN → InsertOrConflict (dedup) → GetByIDForUpdate → status != PENDING_PAYMENT no-op → UpdateStatus(PAID) + history INSERT → COMMIT. Matches TD pseudocode step-for-step. No outbox event emitted (correct).

checks.name: Consumer: 3 stubs registered and routed
checks.detail: RegisterConsumerRoutes returns entries for payment.failed, payment.expired, reservation.expired alongside the full payment.completed handler. All 4 are wired to the kafka.EventRouter. Stubs ack (return nil) without crashing.

checks.name: Outbox emit for events.order.cancelled keyed by orderId
checks.detail: OutboxEvent.AggregateID is defined as orderId (partition key per TD). outbox_events table and storage_outbox.go present. However cancel-mine, update-status-admin, and cancel-on-checkout-failure are STUB → outbox is not yet emitted from those paths in code. The create-from-checkout handler correctly omits outbox (no event on PENDING_PAYMENT creation). Full outbox emission deferred to stub completion.

checks.name: order_items immutable: no Update method
checks.detail: OrderItemStorage (storage_order_item.go) exposes only BulkInsert and ListByOrderID. No Update/Delete method. TD notes deferred trigger; repo discipline enforced in code. Verified no UpdateItem call site in service or handlers.

summary.partial_detail: QA-OB1: outbox emit paths are inside stub handlers (cancel-mine, update-status-admin, cancel-on-checkout-failure). Blocked on stub completion; not a v0.1 defect.
notes: State machine map has 10 allowed entries exactly matching TD; 14 forbidden transitions are covered by implicit-deny + terminal-state fast-path in ValidateTransition.
Internal-auth uses X-Internal-Secret header (not X-Internal-Service-Secret per TD §transport/internal_auth — minor naming delta, functionally equivalent; AMBIG-ORD-1 in play).
RolePaymentSystem alias in domain.go is unused by consumers (all use RoleSystem). Low risk; no AC violation.
order.detail CUSTOMER path reads without FOR UPDATE (correct — read-only, no mutation).
consumed_events consumer_name hardcoded as 'order.payment.completed' string literal — consistent with TD example; should be a package constant in stub completions.
